newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures steady to higher after-hours.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures steady to higher after-hours.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were steady to higher in after-hours trade on Monday, as the yen's falls against the dollar triggered light short-covering by local investors, traders said. The day's volume was 2,766 lots.
Prices were unchanged to 0.7 yen higher against the day's close, with the benchmark June steady at 147.3 yen per kg.

During the day, some months gained on the yen's weak tone against the dollar, but trading was basically quiet, traders said. The spot January, which expires next Monday, had 2,338 lots of positions as of last Friday.
